---
title: "close2"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = ">"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferGraph)
```
<br>

### Argument kind
```{r, echo = TRUE, error = TRUE}
pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf")
grDevices::dev.list() # NULL: the pdf device has been closed
grDevices::graphics.off()
```
<br>

### Argument return_text
```{r, echo = TRUE, error = TRUE}
pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf", return_text = TRUE)
grDevices::dev.list() # NULL: all the pdf devices have been closed
grDevices::graphics.off()

pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf", return_text = FALSE) ; 
grDevices::dev.list() # NULL: all the pdf devices have been closed, but no text displayed because return_text == FALSE
grDevices::graphics.off()
```
<br>

### Argument safer_check 
```{r, echo = TRUE, error = TRUE}
pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf", safer_check = TRUE)
grDevices::dev.list()
grDevices::graphics.off()
```
<br>

### All the arguments
```{r, echo = TRUE, error = TRUE}
pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf", return_text = TRUE, safer_check = TRUE) ; 
grDevices::dev.list()
grDevices::graphics.off()


pdf("file") # open a pdf graphic device
grDevices::dev.list() ; 
close2(kind = "pdf", return_text = FALSE, safer_check = TRUE) ; 
grDevices::dev.list()
grDevices::graphics.off()
```
<br>
